contract_review: The native event append path inherits umask; production-writer tests establish readable 0644/0640 event files inside owner-private attempt directories.

Only event-log reads switch from private to owner_controlled. Both require current effective-UID ownership; owner_controlled rejects group/world write bits. Native binding reads retain the stricter private file mode.
Private native-state and attempt directories are checked before any event read. All absolute directory components are opened without following symlinks.
File observation continues to enforce no-follow/nonblocking regular file, single link, byte/event/JSON bounds, stable inode/mode/owner/time/size and named-path identity.
The allocation still requires a unique owner finished event joined to closed task/attempt/claim/lease/fencing bindings, declared output scope, and coding router receipt.
No public source text, exception text, private path or event payload is newly exported. evidence_stage is assigned only from fixed literal stage labels.
No task authority, completion, writer identity, original allocation inode claim, patch application or reward is established by current output hashes.
Added tests cover native writer modes, bounded-child observations, unsafe writes/owner/links/FIFO, nonprivate directory/binding, changed binding, and event replacement/permission races.
limitations: This review did not rerun a full supervisor or native benchmark. It inspected the separate successful Docker qualification receipts, which explicitly use an authored lifecycle fixture.
Same-owner privileged tampering is not made impossible by mode checks; the observer remains diagnostic and makes no writer identity or historical inode claim.

resolved_followups.action: If comparison-level diagnosis is needed, retain an allowlisted stage enum and test malformed/untrusted values. Direct supervisor report already preserves the stage.
resolved_followups.finding: Comparison export drops the new evidence_stage and replaces the reason with a generic observation label.
resolved_followups.resolution: Comparison now exports exact closed-enum stage only for unavailable observations with the matching producer reason; malformed and legacy stages are omitted.

validation.validation_kind: independent code review plus verification of existing source-bound focused test receipts
